title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo_path <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  repo_only <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", repo_path)
  
  # TRICK: We split the URL so Pandoc's "autolink" filter doesn't catch it
  proto <- "https"
  domain <- "aakritixyz.github.io"
  
  img_src <- paste0(proto, "://", domain, "/", repo_only, "/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0(proto, "://", domain, "/", repo_only, "/")

  cat('<tr>')
  # We use HTML entities for the brackets to stop Pandoc from parsing
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_src, '" width="250"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Interactive Demo</a><br><a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source Code</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</tbody></table>')
